effect.purpose: Read-only Effect v4 source pinned to the tag matching the effect catalog — the authority on what v4 actually exports, plus the v3→v4 migration notes and the @effect/vitest reference implementation. Vendored from the main Effect-TS/effect monorepo, where v4 development resumed after the effect-smol repo was archived.

orientation.layout: Sparse checkout: packages/effect (core source + package.json exports map), packages/vitest (@effect/vitest reference implementation), migration/ (per-domain v3→v4 notes), ai-docs/, LLMS.md, MIGRATION.md. Services/tags live in Context.ts — there is no ServiceMap.ts (agents coming from other Effect lines reliably look for the wrong filename); re-verified at beta.101. Key consumer-side fact settled there: Context.Key<Id, Shape> extends Effect<Shape, never, Id> (Context.ts:65) — v4 tags/Service classes are still first-class Effects, flatMap-able without .asEffect().
orientation.startHere: packages/effect/src settles what v4 actually exports (evidence-ladder rung 2); migration/*.md settles v3→v4 renames (rung 1). Before trusting an answer, check the pin matches the installed effect version — node_modules wins on disagreement.

effected.purpose: Read-only source for the @effected package kit, pinned to the release tag matching the installed @effected/github-actions — the authority on what the kit actually exports and the canonical action patterns this repo is being aligned to.

orientation.layout: pnpm monorepo, one directory per published package under packages/<name>/ with src/, test files co-located, and its own CLAUDE.md. design/ holds the kit's internal design docs. The website/, lib/, plugin/ and lockfile trees are excluded from the sparse checkout.
orientation.startHere: packages/<name>/src/index.ts for a package's real export surface; packages/<name>/CLAUDE.md for the intended usage. Release tags in this repo are PER-PACKAGE (`@effected/<name>@<version>`), not monorepo-wide — the pin names the `@effected/github-actions` tag, and at that commit every other @effected package this repo installs happens to sit at its installed version too. Re-verify that alignment when re-pinning; node_modules still wins on any disagreement.
